critical_code_review_comments: Presentation.jsx is ~1000 lines and could be split into scene files (Scene0..Scene7 + AudioHook) under /pages/presentation/ for maintainability, but functionally OK.
401 errors on /api/auth/me appear in console for non-logged-in visits (expected behavior, but consider returning 200 with null user to avoid noisy console errors).

useCinematicAudio: AudioContext is only created via user gesture (audio button). Good. However on unmount cleanup logs may double-fire because both stopFnRef cleanup and useEffect return cleanup call it. Low risk.
Final CTA only navigates after full 52s playback - good UX; users can use Skip or Final CTA path.
